fit_reason: This is a brand-new 2026 pontoon shown in studio/manufacturer-style photos with dealer marketing copy (any horsepower available, multiple color options), so it is effectively dealer stock rather than a private owner's used boat, despite the private-seller tag.
findings: Studio cutout photos of a new, unused pontoon on a white background
Vinyl seating, woven flooring, gray panels and pontoon tubes all appear factory clean with nothing a detail would change
Rigging area at the stern shows loose wiring from pre-rig, not a detailing issue
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Starcraft GX18R. It looks brand new in the photos, so there isn't anything a detail would change right now. If you ever have a used boat or car to sell, we offer pre-sale details that come to you. Would you like us to keep your contact for a quote down the road?
